rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first license renewal period.
rules.alternatives: Inactive status (not practicing in Wyoming) is exempt; reactivation needs CE for each inactive year, max 5 years.
rules.audit_note: CPE must be reported to NABP CPE Monitor to renew; failing an audit is prima facie evidence of false renewal information.

topics.who: All pharmacists: responsible prescribing of controlled substances (may include pain management/opioids)

rules.notes: CE is earned in the previous license period = calendar year. Pharmacists who will immunize need at least 1 hour on immunizations. Requirement rose from 12 to 15 hours in the 2023 rule revision.
rules.legal_basis: Wyo. Stat. §33-24-121; Wyoming Pharmacy Act Rules ch. 6, §3
